Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

abu I

  • Meaning: "father" (st. constr. abi, occas. abu, ab; nom. with pron. suff. abī, M/NB, NA also abū(y)a; abūšu etc.; pl. abbū, O/MA abbā'ū, MB(Alal.), Am. abbūtu) [AD]
  • Logograms: AD
  • Lines: 7, 113
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abu%20I

abāku I

  • Meaning: "to lead away" OA, NA, M/NB
    • G: (a/u) OA "take (commodities) to"; + vent. "fetch" commodities, animals; often with ippāniya ("myself in person"); Bab. as OA "take to", + vent. "fetch" objects, animals, also people, NB "hale" witness, debtor; NB ana kaspi a. 'take away for silver' = "buy"
    • Gt: Mari "lead away"
    • D: Mari "dispatch, forward" goods; jB "push away, displace"; NA "shift" work onto s.o.
    • Š: jB "have s.o. bring" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G j/NB
  • Lines: 90, 92
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ab%C4%81ku%20I

adāru II

  • Meaning: "to be afraid (of), fear"
    • G: (a/u) NB ēnē a. 'fear the eyes' = "with an eye to, in consideration of"
    • D: "frighten" OA, jB
    • Štn: iter. of Š O/jB
    • Št: pass. of Š
    • N: "become restless, worry about" OA, OB, jB
    • Ntn: iter. of N OA, OB, jB
  • Lines: 88
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%81ru%20II

ahu I

  • Meaning: "brother" (st. constr. ahi, OA ahu/ū; nom. with pron. suff. ahūni/ka; ahī, ahūa "my brother", M/NB ahūya; acc. ahāka; st. abs. ah OAkk, OA in PN; du. ahā OB; pl. ahhū, W.Sem. ahāte, OB after numerals ahānu; st. constr. ahhī OB all cases; with pron. suff. ahhūka) [ŠEŠ; OB also ŠEŠ.A.NI; PAP in later PNs, NA]
  • Logograms: ŠEŠ, ŠEŠ.A.NI,
  • Lines: 43, 98, 104
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ahu%20I

ahāzu I

  • Meaning: "to take; marry; learn"
    • G: (a/u)
    • Gt: "be connected with; well versed in"
    • D: (OA infin. also ehhuzum) "mount, plate, inlay" with metal, stone (< ihzu denom.) [GAR(.RA)]; "marry" pl.
    • Dt: pass. of D
    • Štn: "instruct, inform s.o. repeatedly"; OB of disease "infect repeatedly"
    • Št1: OB "be instructed, incited"?
    • Št2: lex. "ignite" fire, "make" fire "catch"
    • N: pass. of G 2 "marry each other"; of fire etc. "catch, spread";
  • Logograms: GAR, GAR.RA
  • Lines: 11, 14
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ah%C4%81zu%20I

akālu I

  • Meaning: "to eat"
    • G: (a/u) [GU7]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [GU7.GU7]
    • Gt: of lands "ravage each other"; of stars "cover, absorb each other"
    • Š: caus. of G [GU7] "make" men, animals, fire "eat, feed on, consume" food, medication, goods, booty, lands; "steep" an object in liquid; OA "satisfy" a claimant; jB stat. "is infected" with a disease
    • Št: [GU7] OB math. "multiply together", freq. "square" measured lengths N pass. of G [GU7]
  • Logograms: GU7, GU7.GU7
  • Lines: 39
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81lu%20I

Alla I

  • Meaning: —
  • Lines: 42
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/Alla%20I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 41, 59
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 101
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ
  • Lines: 16, 43, 72, 74, 76, 78, 86, 90, 92, 98, 102, 104, 105, 108, 110, 120

    • Gt: (cf. tašābu)
    • D: OB "settle" inhabitants; NB ~ "insert" s.th. (corrupt ?)

    • Gtn: iter. of G [È.MEŠ]
    • Gt: separative of G "go away (for good)"
    • Š: Mari
    • Štn: pass. of Š

banû IV

  • Meaning: "to create; build"
    • G: (i/i) [DÙ] of deity "create" person, grain etc.; of person "engender" child, "make" figurine etc.; "build" house, boat; math. "construct"; ext. of feature "form" a shape
    • D: Am. "erect" city
    • Š: lit., caus. of G
    • N: pass.
  • Logograms: DÙ
  • Lines: 2, 34, 36
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ban%C3%BB%20IV

bašû I

  • Meaning: "to be (at hand, available); exist" [GÁL]
    • G: (i/i; no perf.) "be in existence, available"; of eyes, ears "be fixed on, attentive"; of task, responsibility "lie with" s.o.; of power, characteristic "be owned" by s.o.; pret. ibši "was/were" (emphatic); M/NA pres. ibašši, also pl., as adv. ~ "really, in fact; some"; j/NB mala bašû "as much as there is available, everything, everybody"; adi lā bašê (infin.) 'until non-existence' of destruction, disease
    • Š: "bring into being"
    • N: ingress. of G
    • Ntn: "happen repeatedly"
  • Logograms: GÁL
  • Lines: 61, 63
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ba%C5%A1%C3%BB%20I

elû III

  • Meaning: "to go up, arise; (stat.) is high"
    • G: (i/i) [E11; jB also AN.TA]
    • Gtn: iter.
    • Gt: "go up and away"; of person, animal, silver, illness; O/jB ina X e. "forfeit X"
    • D: "make higher, raise" wall, building, 'head' (rēšu) of building; of deity "lift up, elevate" person, kingship (also with rēšu); "extol, praise (deity)"; NA "take away, remove"
    • Dtn: "repeatedly extol"
    • Š: [E11] caus. of G; jB ana zaqīpi š. "impale"; "post, install" garrison in fort etc.; Susa mê š. "have water close over one, be submerged" (in ordeal); "dedicate" to temple; "get out" from storage, kiln; "embark" person, goods; "bring forward" witnesses; "produce" lesion; "bring out, produce" tablet, lost property; "enter" on tablet; "introduce" bees to a region; "express" anxiety, thought; šum X š. "swear oath by X"; "disinherit" heir, "turn off, drive from" fields, land; "take" sheep from fold; "remove" boundary stone etc.; math.
